_about: BC standing-committee transcript seed list.
Operator-curated catalog of known BC standing/special-committee transcript
URLs on lims.leg.bc.ca/hdms/file/Committees/{parl}{sess}/{code}/.
WHY THIS EXISTS:
BC has no structured listing endpoint for standing-committee transcripts.
Probed exhaustively on 2026-05-19 — LIMS HDMS /hdms/committees/{parl}{sess}
returns 404; HDMS directory listings return 404; LIMS GraphQL has zero
committee fields; leg.bc.ca per-committee pages are SPA-rendered with no
meeting dates in static HTML; Drupal /jsonapi/ + ?_format=json are both
disabled. Per-transcript URL fetch works cleanly (200 OK, ~140KB HTML)
once the specific filename is known, so v1 ships with an operator-curated
seed: the ingester reads this file and is correct + idempotent over
whatever set it sees.
ADDING NEW MEETINGS:
1. Find the transcript URL (Google site:lims.leg.bc.ca, or paste a known
URL from leg.bc.ca's committee page).
2. Append to the appropriate committee's transcript_urls list.
3. Re-run ingest-bc-committees (idempotent on canonical_url).
